## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `microsoft-sharepoint-pages-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

2. In the left-hand navigation menu, select **Microsoft Entra ID** in the top search bar.
3. <!-- manual: In the left panel, navigate to App registrations and click New registration. -->
4. <!-- manual: Enter a name for your application, select the appropriate Supported account types (e.g., "Single tenant only"), and click Register. -->
